subject: CloudNova trial — evaluation guardrails, success criteria & blockers
summary: Post-discovery recap and POC planning for CloudNova: define measurable success criteria, assign owners, list blocking risks with mitigations, confirm timeline (2-week trial + 1-week integration), and circulate SOW for approval.
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@cloudnova.io>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: CloudNova trial — next steps and proposed evaluation scope

Hi Priya,

Great conversation today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and a proposed plan to get the trial moving: 

Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for CloudNova's customer search and internal knowledge chat flows.

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
- Integration: embed API (search + chat) into one existing internal app (non-prod).
- Load: baseline 500 qps simulated for search slice; 95th pct latency target <150ms.
- Quality: precision@10 for embeddings baseline >= 0.78 on your sample set.
- Cost/run: establish per-million-token cost estimate for projected traffic.

Owners:
- Sales (me): commercial terms, SOW, procurement touchpoints.
- SE (cc'd): technical runbook, test harness.
- Eng (if needed): network/security questions.

Blocking items we flagged: SOC2 evidence, network egress constraints, and sample data for relevance testing. If those are OK, we can start onboarding next week. I attached a SOW draft and the simple network diagram we discussed.

Next steps: Can you confirm required success criteria and the internal stakeholders who will own the pass/fail call? Also, any procurement timing we should know about?

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Martinez | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
From: Priya Shah <priya@cloudnova.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khatri <samir@cloudnova.io>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNova trial — next steps and proposed evaluation scope

Alex — thanks for the recap. This mirrors what we want. A few clarifications: 

1) Success criteria owner: I'll own quality metrics on our side (data team). Samir will own performance and infra. Final pass/fail will be product + security.
2) SOC2: we require a subset of evidence (control matrix + attestation) to run with customer data even in non-prod. Can you provide a link or snapshot?
3) Network: Our security team requires outbound connections only to whitelisted IPs (no NAT egress to broad ranges). Is a static IP or VPC peering option available for Redwood Private or Dedicated?
4) Timeline: procurement would like a SOW by EOD 5/9.

We'll share a small labeled relevance test set (anonymized) by 5/4. Please include billing cadence in SOW.

—Priya
Priya Shah | Head of Data Platform, CloudNova
priya@cloudnova.io | +1 617-555-4892
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@cloudnova.io>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudNova trial — next steps and proposed evaluation scope

Folks — forwarding Priya's clarifications. Can SE + security ops validate feasibility and propose mitigations for the blockers below?

Key asks from CloudNova:
- Provide SOC2 evidence subset (control matrix + attestation).
- Support whitelisted egress (static IP or VPC peering) for the trial.
- Confirm we can meet latency target under 500 qps simulation.

Sooj, can you draft a minimal technical runbook (onboarding steps, test harness, sample curl commands, metrics to collect) and list any infra prerequisites? Marcus — FYI on the procurement deadline (SOW by 5/9).

Thanks,
Alex
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@cloudnova.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNova trial — technical runbook, risks & mitigations

Hi all — high level technical plan and risk register below. Attaching steps we will follow in the Drive doc (linked in related_links).

POC runbook (summary):
- Day 0: Exchange keys, IP whitelist, and test account provisioning.
- Day 1: Ingest sample dataset; run embedding baseline tests (precision@10).
- Day 2–4: Load/latency tests with continuous batching configs; capture p50/p95/p99.
- Day 5–7: Quality/edge-case testing (hallucination spot checks, safety filters).
- Final: Joint review and pass/fail decision.

Risk register (blocking-first):
- R1: SOC2 evidence gap (severity: high) — Mitigation: Provide SOC2 summary + control mapping PDF; offer NDA + isolated project environment. Escalation: Marcus.
- R2: Network egress (severity: high) — Mitigation: Use Reserved Dedicated IP or allowlist our ingestion endpoint; if not possible, propose short-term AWS VPC Peering for trial. Escalation: infra team (cc Marcus).
- R3: Data access & PII (severity: medium) — Mitigation: Only accept anonymized test set; use short TTL logs; enable encryption at rest and in transit.
- R4: Model quality variance (severity: medium) — Mitigation: Provide prompt templates, system messages, and a rollback to a smaller model variant for cost/perf tradeoff.
- R5: Billing/quotas surprise (severity: low) — Mitigation: Hard quota enforcement on trial account and daily cost reports.

Open action items (owners):
- Soojin: deliver runbook + test harness repo by 5/6.
- Alex: update SOW with billing cadence and send to procurement by 5/9.
- Marcus: provide SOC2 evidence link and confirm IP allowlist options by 5/7.
- Priya: share anonymized relevance dataset by 5/4.

I believe all of these are solvable within the proposed timeline provided we get the dataset and SOC2 thumbs-up.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@cloudnova.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T10:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNova trial — SOC2 evidence and IP allowlist

Alex / Priya — I've uploaded the SOC2 summary and control mapping to the shared Drive folder (link above). Short answers:

- SOC2: we can share the summary + control mapping and an attestation letter under NDA today. Full report available under a redaction/controlled view for procurement.
- IP allowlist: For trials we can allocate a static egress IP from Redwood Dedicated for a short window. If CloudNova prefers VPC peering, we can engage engineering but that will add 3–5 business days.

Escalation path: 
- If SOC2 evidence fails to meet CloudNova's bar, Marcus (me) -> Head of Security (Lauren) -> CTO for exception.
- If performance is degraded in non-prod vs expectations, SE lead (Soojin) will triage with infra; escalate to product if a kernel/serving issue is suspected.

I'll confirm the specific egress IP by EOD 5/7 and sync with procurement on the SOW wording.

Marcus Lin | Director, Enterprise Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@cloudnova.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNova trial — evaluation guardrails, success criteria & blockers

Priya — thanks for the confirmations over the last week. Final checklist before we kick off next Monday (5/10):

- SOW: attached (CloudNova-POC-SOW-draft.pdf). Billing cadence: monthly in arrears; trial hard-quotas enabled.
- Technical runbook: Soojin delivered (see Drive link).
- SOC2: Marcus uploaded summary; we can provide attestation under NDA (see related_links).
- IP: Redwood will provide a static egress IP for the trial window.
- Data: waiting on your anonymized test set (Samir/Priya) — please upload by EOD 5/10.

Immediate next steps (owners & dates):
- Alex: Send final SOW to procurement and DocuSign by 5/9 (DONE, attached).
- Soojin: Provision test account and run initial ingest by 5/11.
- Priya: Provide dataset and confirm internal reviewers by 5/10.
- Marcus: Confirm egress IP and SOC attestation path by 5/10.

If anything changes, flag immediately. Looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Alex

Attachments: CloudNova-POC-SOW-draft.pdf, network-diagram.png, security-questionnaire.xlsx
